fullPassage: All scarce resources are rival, meaning that use by one person leaves less of the resource (in quality or quantity) for others to use. Many resources, however, are non-rival, which means that use by one person does not leave less for others to use. When this is true, there is no competition for use and the resource is not scarce in an economic sense, even if total supply is inadequate. Examples include streetlights, many different ecosystem services, and information. Price rationing in this case reduces use and hence value to society without affecting quantity, which is inefficient. For example, if someone develops a cheap, clean solar energy technology and then patents it (which makes it excludable), it can be sold at a price. A positive price will reduce use, leading to less substitution away from competing energy sources, such as coal, and society as a whole suffers. Markets will only provide non-rival resources if they are made excludable and can be sold at a price, but this creates artificial scarcity. Paradoxically, the value of non-rival resources to society is maximized at a price of zero, but at that price, markets will not provide it.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ③ what → which (계속적 용법 관계대명사)
det.analysis:
✅ ① meaning: 'All scarce resources are rival, meaning that ~'에서 분사구문(= which means)으로 올바른 어법
✅ ② are: 'Many resources, however, are non-rival'에서 복수 주어 resources에 복수 동사로 올바른 어법
❌ ③ what → which: 'Many resources are non-rival, which means ~'에서 앞 절 전체를 선행사로 받는 계속적 용법의 관계대명사 which가 필요. what은 선행사를 포함하는 관계대명사로 이 자리에 부적절
✅ ④ reduces: 'Price rationing in this case reduces ~'에서 단수 주어 Price rationing에 대한 3인칭 단수 동사로 올바른 어법
det.tip: 콤마 뒤에서 앞 절 전체를 선행사로 받을 때는 which(계속적 용법)를 씁니다. what은 선행사를 포함하는 관계대명사(= the thing that)이므로 이 자리에 쓸 수 없습니다.

det.analysis:
✅ ① rival(경쟁적인): 희소 자원은 한 사람의 사용이 다른 사람에게 남는 양을 줄이므로 '경쟁적'이라는 맥락에 적절

✅ ③ inefficient(비효율적인): 가격 배급이 사용을 줄여 사회적 가치를 감소시키므로 '비효율적'이라는 평가에 적절
✅ ④ artificial(인위적인): 배제성을 부여하면 '인위적 희소성'이 생긴다는 논지에 적절
